ContextMenu_UP_SprayPerfume_Tooltip: Spray this perfume. The aroma lasts 4 hours.
ContextMenu_UP_Respray_Tooltip: You are still scented: the same perfume refills the aroma to 4 hours, a different one replaces the current effect and lasts a full 4 hours.
ContextMenu_UP_Empty_Tooltip: Less than one dose remains in this bottle.
ContextMenu_UP_MergeAll_Tooltip: Consolidate every bottle of this perfume into as few bottles as possible. Empty bottles are kept.
